title: Quick Buttery Peruvian Morcilla Papa Rellena
description: A buttery and creamy Peruvian dish featuring morcilla, with a rich deglaze fond, made into a papa rellena form, Whole30 friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Boil the potatoes until they are tender, then let them cool.
Slice the potatoes in half and scoop out the flesh to make a hole for the filling.
Cook the morcilla in a pan over medium heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the butter, onions, and garlic to the pan and cook until the onions are translucent.
Add the cooked morcilla mixture to the potato flesh and mix well.
Stuff each potato shell with the morcilla mixture and place on a baking sheet.
Sprinkle the tops with paprika and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
